rules.sentence: Pulmonary hypertension is defined as an increase in the blood pressure of the arteries of the pulmonary system.
Pulmonary veno-occlusive disease is a rare cause of pulmonary hypertension and primarily involves the venous system.
Early symptoms for patients typically include shortness of breath or swelling in the legs.
This can eventually progress to worsening shortness of breath on exertion, abdominal swelling, and low oxygen levels.
